    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int Credits { get; set; }

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace UniversityCourseCatalog.Models;

public class EnrollmentRequest
{
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Name is required.")]
    [StringLength(100)]
    public string StudentName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Student ID is required.")]
    [RegularExpression(@"^[A-Za-z0-9]{6,12}$", ErrorMessage = "Student ID must be 6–12 alphanumeric characters.")]

- `IReadOnlyList<Course> GetFeaturedCourses()`

- At least 5 departments: Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, English, History
- At least 3-4 courses per department (15+ total courses)
- Realistic course codes, titles, descriptions, schedules, instructor names and short bios
- Mark 4-5 courses as featured
- Search filters by title or course code (case-insensitive contains)
- Department filter works

- Home (href="")
- Courses (href="courses")
- Enroll (href="enroll")

Change the navbar brand to "University Course Catalog".

- PageTitle "University Course Catalog"
- Welcome heading and short intro paragraph

- "Departments" section: list of departments as links to the courses page filtered by that department (`/courses?departmentId=X`)

**Courses.razor** — route "/courses", interactive server rendering
- PageTitle "Course Catalog"
- Search box (text input) and department dropdown filter
- Apply filters on button click (or on change)
- Results displayed as a Bootstrap table with columns: Course Code, Title, Department, Credits, Schedule, and a "Details" link

- Keep it clean and professional — university feel
